business_problem: Trade Me wanted to turn a marketplace and engineering organization into an AI-first ecosystem, which meant replacing physical data centers, accelerating incident diagnosis, and letting employees query marketplace trends without specialized code.
solution_summary: Trade Me uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Trade Me wanted to turn a marketplace and engineering organization into an AI-first ecosystem, which meant replacing physical data centers, accelerating incident diagnosis, and letting employees query marketplace trends without specialized code. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform provides the managed agent runtime that powers internal automation and future engineering-efficiency gains, serving as the serving layer. Agent Development Kit wraps existing APIs and enables specialized agents such as the Incident Agent, serving as the orchestration layer. BigQuery grounds the marketplace agents in operational and trend data that employees can query in natural language, serving as the storage layer. Cloud Run supports the critical APIs that now run with four nines of availability, serving as the serving layer. AlloyDB backs the critical API layer in the cloud-native marketplace stack, serving as the storage layer.
